title: Visual stories
summary: This page provides visual stories to help you understand the process for various services at a Service NSW Service Centre.

internal_links.text: Your first visit A visual story to help you understand what to expect when you visit a Service NSW Service Centre.
Applying for a Photo Card A visual story to help you apply for a NSW Photo Card at a Service NSW Service Centre.
Applying for a Mobility Parking Scheme (MPS) Permit A visual story to help you apply for a Mobility Parking Scheme (MPS) Permit at a Service NSW Service Centre.

faqs.a: A visual story is a guide that helps you understand what to expect when completing a service process at a Service NSW Service Centre.

faqs.q: Can I use a visual story to apply for a Photo Card?
faqs.a: Yes, there is a visual story available to help you apply for a NSW Photo Card at a Service NSW Service Centre.

faqs.q: How can I prepare for my first visit to a Service NSW Service Centre?
faqs.a: You can view a visual story to help you understand what to expect when you visit a Service NSW Service Centre.
